claims.units_and_conditions: 6000 rpm stated; context implies crankshaft rpm
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Repeated elsewhere; no original test or OEM page given.
claims.required_validation: Verify model-year and flow in factory literature.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Targalid reports approximately 20°F lower temperature after 245 mm eleven-blade swap; Flat6pac corrects his small-fan years to 1978–79.
claims.units_and_conditions: 1976 911S signature; ambient, load and sensor unspecified
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Targalid initially guessed 1980–81; not a controlled comparison.
claims.required_validation: Repeat with oil and six head temperatures under matched load.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Says 1984–89 rotor has alternator cooling slots and works with stock 1976–77 pulley halves.
claims.units_and_conditions: 245 mm retrofit context
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Not a full alternator/offset interchange matrix.
claims.required_validation: Check rotor, housing, shaft and pulley stack together.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports anemometer readings of 24 m³/min for modified 964 rotor versus 30 m³/min for original 911 rotor at 3000 rpm.
claims.units_and_conditions: Rotor OD reduced, axial length shortened, original hub removed, custom hub; original 3.2 alternator/housing retained
claims.confidence_for_engineering_use: medium as experiment; low transferable accuracy
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Measurement plane, traverse, calibration, backpressure and rpm definition not fully documented. This is not stock 964 performance.
claims.required_validation: Reproduce exact geometry and full Q–pressure–power map.

claims.paraphrased_claim: After a second conversion and hundreds of kilometres, Rob reports less noise and no hotter indicated engine temperature at roughly 35°C, in traffic and Autobahn use.
claims.units_and_conditions: 35°C / 95°F; large front oil cooler; no dB values
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Reply asks for cylinder/head temperatures; none supplied in inspected page.
claims.required_validation: Measure six head temperatures; oil gauge alone cannot validate cooling uniformity.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports reducing crank-pulley diameter in 2.5 GTU IMSA work increased power while cooling stayed constant; describes own underdrive products.
claims.units_and_conditions: Race duty; no numerical torque/temperature trace
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: No logged A/B results or pulley conditions; not a street-car prescription.
claims.required_validation: Instrument matched-load dyno and thermal tests.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Discussion distinguishes belt effective diameter from outer pulley size. Trackrash identifies 130 mm crank and 90 mm early fan pulley while reporting about 1.6 ratio.
claims.units_and_conditions: Declared outer dimensions do not directly yield 1.6
claims.evidence_type: photo-backed assembly description plus calculation discussion
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: 130/90 is about 1.44; pitch diameter, belt position and measurement convention matter.
claims.required_validation: Measure shaft speeds simultaneously; record belt section and groove pitch diameters.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Table labels fan-tip velocity ft/s: five-blade 245 mm, 6100 crank rpm, 1.8 ratio gives about 462 ft/s. It lists 279.4 mm for 964/993.
claims.units_and_conditions: Table is reposted context, not dimensional measurement
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Another post calls the roughly 460 number mph. The 279.4 mm entry is not accepted rotor OD.
claims.required_validation: Recalculate from measured OD and actual shaft rpm; resolve housing versus rotor dimensions.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Installed shroud static tap and flow hood on 3.2 transplant; measured to 6000 rpm; initially inferred much higher resistance and about half expected flow against an earlier Porsche curve.
claims.units_and_conditions: 1969 Targa with 3.2; stationary test; taped leaks; redirected induction
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Author later reports unreliable shroud pressure due to turbulence (F06/F07). Initial result does not establish an OEM design defect.
claims.required_validation: Independent calibrated chamber and engine system-resistance measurements.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports 964 fan/alternator/shroud tested against a 20×20 inch radiator, driven by 3 hp three-phase motor/VFD and checked with strobe. Nine rpm/CFM pairs retained separately.
claims.units_and_conditions: Reported speed 1951–13758 rpm; radiator about 40 tubes; pressure measurement unsuccessful
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Not Porsche engine resistance. Wording confuses motor/fan rpm; column treated as reported rpm only.
claims.required_validation: Verify measurement plane, rpm shaft, leakage, static pressure and instrument calibration.

claims.paraphrased_claim: States reliable pressure could not be measured inside turbulent fan shroud; used 2 ft square ×12 ft chamber with straighteners and interchangeable orifice plates.
claims.units_and_conditions: Orifice differential pressure used for flow
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: No complete calibrated dataset provided here.
claims.required_validation: Document chamber calibration, reference taps and full operating envelope.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports Porsche Werks staff thought the circulated Forstner pressure curve might describe an early prototype. His separate fan dynamometer/tunnel project was paused before new data.
claims.units_and_conditions: Personal report of conversation, not an OEM statement
claims.evidence_type: firsthand project status; secondhand historical assertion
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Search result publication age points to later bump; actual technical post is 2010.
claims.required_validation: Locate original Forstner source and factory test conditions.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Lists later NA 964/993 rotor 96410601531; 964 3.6T/993TT 96410601521; pre-1992 964 requires additional mounting hardware. Separates 964 3.3T.
claims.units_and_conditions: Historical part identifiers
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: No PET revision/engine breakpoints shown; current supersessions not established.
claims.required_validation: Cross-check PET by engine code, year and alternator variant.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports cracked blade slightly proud, light housing contact after painting, recurrence when warm and visible hub wobble; prior alternator seating interference suspected.
claims.units_and_conditions: Owned car about 5000 miles; no runout gauge
claims.confidence_for_engineering_use: medium for symptom; low for cause
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Grinding/sanding recounted by owner is not endorsed repair advice.
claims.required_validation: Inspect bearing, hub, seating and hot/cold concentricity; reject cracked rotor.

claims.paraphrased_claim: 1996 993, 129000 miles: burning/thrown belts; estimated 1–2 mm axial tip runout, tip contact, hub coating cracks and corroded blade edges. New fan later showed >1 mm tip rocking by light hand pressure.
claims.units_and_conditions: Eyeballed displacement; hand force unmeasured
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Replacement bearing fit and housing clamping remained unresolved in excerpt; not permissible runout limits.
claims.required_validation: Dial-indicator runout, bearing clearance, shaft inspection and stack verification.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports top clearance .014 and bottom zero before and after alternator rebuild/fan-bearing replacement.
claims.units_and_conditions: Unit not stated in post; do not silently label inches or mm
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: A damaged/rubbing assembly, not a factory clearance specification.
claims.required_validation: Measure calibrated radial clearance around full circumference with mounting torqued.

claims.paraphrased_claim: After powder-coating and trimming tips, owner finds a heavy side on low-friction shaft fixture; attempts added shallow holes without much change.
claims.units_and_conditions: Static fixture; no residual unbalance recorded
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Static balance is not a dynamic balance certificate. Do not reproduce drilling instructions as an approved repair.
claims.required_validation: Professional dynamic balancing and dimensional/NDT inspection after any material alteration.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports decades of race-engine experience without rebalancing original cast fans, including engines above 8000 rpm.
claims.units_and_conditions: Engine rpm, not declared fan rpm
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Does not validate damaged, coated, machined or newly designed rotors.
claims.required_validation: Define residual-unbalance target and bearing/support loads for exact assembly.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Participants propose tool-induced blade-root overload, corrosion and fan-bearing contact as alternative causes; worn coating at tips could expose magnesium.
claims.units_and_conditions: Photo-based diagnosis; coating/process history unknown
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Powder-coat heat warning is asserted without alloy, oven cycle or metallurgical evidence.
claims.required_validation: Fractography, alloy identification, dimensional inspection and qualified coating process.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports two roughly 2 cm cracks toward blade centres; a 0.25 mm feeler would not enter. Others disagree over monitoring versus replacement.
claims.units_and_conditions: Crack opening only; no depth or growth measurement
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Small crack opening does not establish structural safety; paint cannot restore strength.
claims.required_validation: NDT and replacement/engineering disposition; do not use as crack-acceptance criterion.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Owner reports one vane crack and cracks near balancing holes; replacement reportedly had a guide-vane casting flaw and porosity exposed in several balancing holes.
claims.units_and_conditions: 993 context; no batch number or defect measurements
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Appearance alone does not establish defect class or manufacturer-wide rate.
claims.required_validation: Inspect actual part, NDT and supplier disposition; document lot and coating.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Side-by-side owner photos are described as same rotor geometry for 2.4 and 3.2, but differently shaped hub affecting pulley ratio.
claims.units_and_conditions: No caliper dimensions; photos listed in post
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Later assertion that hub contributes little balance effect is not a balance measurement.
claims.required_validation: Scan both exact parts, flange offsets, rivet pattern and pulley profile.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Distinguishes NA M64 12 swept blades from 964 Turbo 3.3 M30/69 rotor with 11 straight blades and three M6 central fasteners.
claims.units_and_conditions: 320 PS 3.3 Turbo explicitly specified
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Counters generic “964 fan” labelling; does not cover every Turbo generation.
claims.required_validation: Verify casting/part number and factory mounting drawing.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Explicitly reuses Anderson/Pelican table; notes missing 1980-onward 245 mm/11-blade row and says “997” in one reproduced table should be “993”.
claims.units_and_conditions: 1.68 ratio; 1500 L/s at 6000 rpm quoted
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: German repetition is not independent corroboration of English table.
claims.required_validation: Trace edition/page and confirm against Porsche primary documentation.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Community specification page calls Carrera 3.0 five-blade fan 226 mm, while other inspected tables say 245 mm; separately lists SC 1978–79 226 mm and 1980 245 mm.
claims.units_and_conditions: No primary citation or direct measurement
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Do not average conflicting 226/245 values or treat this as measured diameter.
claims.required_validation: Resolve with exact part-number factory source or physical measurement.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports broken/loose rivet at rear alternator cap deflector, associated fatigue cracks, and initially forgotten spacer between alternator and fan.
claims.units_and_conditions: Assembly restoration, about 180000 km stated
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Not rotor fatigue data; distinguishes rear deflector from rotating blades.
claims.required_validation: Include deflector attachment and axial spacer stack in digital-twin assembly schema.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports cracked housing with missing pieces; replacement used housing still required adjustment; heater duct curvature also interfered with distributor adjustment.
claims.units_and_conditions: SC restoration; no dimensional measurements
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Specific repaired assembly; not evidence all replacement housings require machining.
claims.required_validation: Model surrounding clearances and verify exact casting before reuse.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Owner says dry-carbon fan seems to contact housing and carbon fibres at blade tips are breaking down.
claims.units_and_conditions: 993 Carrera; brand and dimensions unspecified
claims.evidence_type: firsthand owner failure observation; image linked
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: No brand attribution, material specification, clearance or balance measurements.
claims.required_validation: Check cold/hot dynamic clearance, laminate damage and assembly alignment; retain supplier anonymity unless verified.

claims.author_pseudonym: ハセヤン; comment げんた君
claims.paraphrased_claim: Owner replacement diary and commenter discussing delicate fan/shroud gap located.
claims.units_and_conditions: 993 Carrera
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: No numeric gap or complete repair account recovered.
claims.required_validation: Read full public diary/photo sequence before promoting any claim.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Workshop diagnoses metallic engine-bay noise as deteriorated fan bearing allowing blade/shroud contact; documents replacement and subsequent normal operation.
claims.units_and_conditions: 993 Carrera customer repair
claims.evidence_type: firsthand professional repair account; photos linked
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: No clearance, bearing-play or vibration measurements; asserted hood-damage risk is not this case outcome.
claims.required_validation: Measure bearing-related rotor excursion and include it in tolerance budget.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Recalls switching Carrera 3.0 to eleven blades in hot summer 2003 and observing oil approximately 15°C cooler.
claims.units_and_conditions: Retrospective 2016 report of 2003 use
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Mauro/silver reports no trouble with five blades; ambient/load/pulley setup not recorded.
claims.required_validation: Matched-load comparison with calibrated oil/head thermometry.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Clarifies five-blade application as MY1976–77, including cars built late 1975; gives 245 mm.
claims.units_and_conditions: Model year vs calendar production date
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Earlier post broadly says 1975–77; retain distinction.
claims.required_validation: Cross-check factory model-year documentation.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports 10×700 versus 10×710 belt, about 9–10 mm smaller running diameter and circumferences 257 versus 226 mm; estimates 14% speed rise but calculates 1.65→1.74.
claims.units_and_conditions: Claims 7 shims / about 3.5 mm in later post; noticed slip
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Ratio arithmetic is inconsistent: 1.65×257/226 ≈1.876. Pitch location and slip unverified.
claims.required_validation: Direct optical shaft-speed measurement; do not adopt belt change as validated upgrade.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Original 710 belt baseline: tube-mounted sensor reached 45°C in reported 5.20–5.40 minutes at 27.5°C ambient and about 900 engine rpm; shorter-belt comparison planned.
claims.units_and_conditions: Sensor on thermostat return tube; preserve ambiguous minute notation
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: No completed paired result in inspected thread; tube temperature is not head temperature.
claims.required_validation: Repeat both configurations with identical starting temperatures and calibrated sensors.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Owner reports metallic noise, damage to almost all blades, housing scrape marks, and light rubbing after near-inactivity for two years; confirms coastal storage context.
claims.units_and_conditions: Less than 1000 km over previous two years
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Participants debate corrosion-first versus misalignment-first; cause not established. Owner reports repair January 2018 without specifying treatment.
claims.required_validation: NDT, bearing/shaft inspection and coating history; no safe-to-drive inference.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Thread juxtaposes 30+ bhp claim with 7–16 bhp estimates, a 10 bhp 3.2 claim and copied 917 data; no direct 911 fan dynamometer result.
claims.units_and_conditions: Different motors and duty cycles mixed
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Copied 917 airflow is labelled L/min; other 917 accounts say L/s. Not 911/993 performance.
claims.required_validation: Return to original test report; distinguish fan shaft power and alternator load.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Jonny Hart says Singer DLS-T uses roughly 80 A brushless horizontal fan; sfl993t4 points out cylinder-only cooling because heads are liquid cooled.
claims.units_and_conditions: 80 A at 12 V is about 960 W electrical; source calls about 1.3 hp
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Does not show an electric substitute can cool fully air-cooled 911 heads.
claims.required_validation: Verify architecture with builder and thermal duty before comparison.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Replica builder describes pressure-lubricated spiral-bevel gearbox, rotor/stator and planned Andial A/B cylinder-temperature tests; claims up to 1600 L/s and more even cooling.
claims.units_and_conditions: Prototype status; claimed threshold above 450 hp
claims.evidence_type: firsthand development status; unverified performance assertions
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Future-tense testing is not completed evidence. Other threads cite different power thresholds.
claims.required_validation: Locate completed dyno/temperature results and original 935 engineering drawings.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Seller says early factory 934 flat fans were cast aluminium and heavier than seller assembly.
claims.units_and_conditions: Sales claim; rotor architecture/model identification needs verification
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: No weights/material certificate; do not transfer to 935 variants.
claims.required_validation: Read complete sales post and obtain exact product drawing/material/weight evidence.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Flags that catalogue listing includes 1979 SC although original 226 mm rotor would need different fan; also flags anodised housing electrical-ground continuity.
claims.units_and_conditions: Billet housing, not a measured billet rotor flow comparison
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: No installed flow/thermal result in inspected excerpt; prices and availability historical.
claims.required_validation: Check housing bore, spacer selection, alternator location and electrical bonding.

claims.paraphrased_claim: After switching from five to eleven blades, owner reports cooler operation, less noise and perceived reduced performance; explicitly wonders whether quieter sound affects impression.
claims.units_and_conditions: No dynamometer data
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Perceived acceleration is not measured parasitic horsepower.
claims.required_validation: Shaft-power or matched engine-dyno testing; calibrated acoustics.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reports replacing stock five-blade with 1984 Carrera fan produced little or no oil-temperature reduction; assumes head temperatures improved without measuring.
claims.units_and_conditions: Own modified-car context not fully specified in excerpt
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Contrasts with F01/F24 oil-temperature drops; setups and duty differ.
claims.required_validation: Do not pool anecdotes as effect size; use controlled oil/head comparison.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Quoted Jeroen914 claims tests show equal five/eleven-blade flow and change was for noise; Charles says his temperature remains satisfactory.
claims.units_and_conditions: Test citation and ratios absent
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Equal flow assertion conflicts with frequently copied factory-style table.
claims.required_validation: Locate original test and compare equal rpm versus equal crank rpm.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Discussion reports unequal cylinder cooling for off-the-shelf Porsche-style VW shrouds and absence of internal guide vanes.
claims.units_and_conditions: Four-cylinder VW application, not six-cylinder Porsche shroud
claims.evidence_type: test claim in forum; full protocol not recovered
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: Do not transfer cylinder numbering or quantitative effectiveness to 911.
claims.required_validation: Read original instrumented conversion tests and retain engine/shroud geometry labels.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Participants dispute 25–30 hp Porsche-fan claims by comparing belt slip and debate existence/identity of 12-blade variants.
claims.units_and_conditions: VW conversion context
claims.caveat_or_contradiction: No measured torque shown in excerpt; neither argument supplies a 911 fan map.
claims.required_validation: Trace named measurements and independently calibrate belt-drive losses.
